simulated_addition.ponder.low_air_resist: Low air resistance and low lift
Wooden sails and wooden symmetric sails have half the thrust, lift, and air resistance compared to wool sails.
Furthermore, when used as sails for a windmill, at least eight are required.
simulated_addition.ponder.low_friction.t: Floatite is lighter and has no lateral friction compared to Levitite.
Therefore, it is extremely useful for contraptions that require high-speed movement on the water, such as with seaplanes and high-speed boards.
simulated_addition.ponder.suppress_thrus: Gyroscopic Propeller Bearings and Directional Gyroscopic Propeller Bearings can stabilize contraptions with a high center of gravity when mounted facing downwards, but...
The thrust leaks laterally, causing unintended movement.
Using a Directional Gyroscopic Propeller Bearing allows you to offset and compensate for thrust leakage.
However, depending on the center of gravity, the contraption may tilt at a considerable angle, so caution is necessary.
simulated_addition.ponder.thrust_vectori: Directional Propeller Bearing tilts thrust in the direction of the redstone signal.
Therefore, it is useful for airships with simple structures and aircraft with extremely poor turning performance.
Directional Gyroscopic Propeller Bearings stabilize contraptions while tilting thrust in the direction of the redstone signal.
Therefore, it is useful for vehicles such as helicopters.
simulated_addition.ponder.very_heavy.tex: Ballasite has a very high mass and is excellent at adjusting the center of gravity.
simulated_addition.ponder.very_strong_bu: Floatite has very strong buoyancy and is lightweight compared to other blocks.
Therefore, even with only a small number of floatites attached, it is possible to make very heavy contraptions float on water.
